Erin Wang is a first-year graduate student obtaining a Master of Science in Electrical Engineering at [Stanford University](https://online.stanford.edu/programs/electrical-engineering-ms-degree). She received her Bachelor of Science as an engineering major at [Harvey Mudd College](https://hmc.edu). Her interests are in robotics and mechatronics, specifically for building animatronics in theme parks. One of her personal projects is to build the robot from the REPO game with 3D printed material and off-the-shelf servo motors. The link to her Github can be found [here](https://github.com/erinlywang). Notable projects from her time at Harvey Mudd include "ENGR155: Microprocessor-based Systems: Design & Applications" where she published her progress on the labs on her own [E155 Website](https://erinlywang.github.io/e155-quarto-portfolio/).

After graduate school, she aims to apply for jobs in building life-like robotics, especially for applications in entertainment as well as accessibility. Her mom says she cannot wait for Erin to build her a robot that will clean bathrooms. When she is not working hard in her classes, music and food fill her life. She loves to dance and sing as well as compose music, and she is always willing to try a new food place.
